title: Generate legible OG social cards and programmatic release videos respecting safe zones and renderer constraints

contextSnapshot.surface: 1200x630 Open Graph card, YouTube 1280x720 thumbnail, and 16:9/9:16 release clip

prompt: Build an automated Open Graph card generator and a short release announcement video pipeline with safe zones for X/LinkedIn/Discord/YouTube and captions.
forbiddenBehaviors: uses unsupported CSS Grid or missing font buffers inside Satori without switching to Takumi or Playwright capture
places essential text inside YouTube bottom-right timestamp or social crop edges, or invents user counts/awards
exports uncaptioned video or uses incompatible pixel formats without yuv420p/faststart verification

rubricDimensions.pass: keeps focal message inside conservative platform safe zones, verifies legibility at feed thumbnail scale, and preserves truthfulness
rubricDimensions.fail: packs dense tiny code screenshots or puts labels in platform overlay zones

rubricDimensions.pass: respects Satori vs Takumi/Sharp/Playwright constraints, loads fonts properly, handles Next.js Node vs Edge runtime limits, and exports captioned yuv420p/+faststart video with cache-busting metadata
rubricDimensions.fail: assumes full browser CSS inside Satori or ignores video playback compatibility and captions

negativeControls.name: full-size 1200x630 inspection only
negativeControls.input: the card looks crisp at 100% zoom on a 4K display
negativeControls.mustNot: claim feed thumbnail legibility or platform recompression survival without inspecting scaled output

baseline.withoutSkill: writes CSS Grid inside Satori that fails at runtime, crowds text into crop zones, adds generic sparkle badges, and skips video captions and yuv420p flags
baseline.withSkill: matches the renderer to layout needs, respects platform safe zones and thumbnail scale, keeps claims truthful, and verifies export metadata and captions
